$comment: Case Studies section: header copy and the case-study cards. Editable content — safe for a CMS. CARD SHAPE: `hook` is the one-line human truth (kept short — it is set large, so ~10 words max); `summary` is the one-line proof of work and is the card's SEO payload (keep the service keywords a client would actually search — 'local SEO', 'Google Ads', 'CRM automation', 'go-to-market' — and keep it under ~28 words); `shifts` renders the Before → After ledger — each row is one honest before-state pulled from the brief and one stated result, with `fill` (0-100) sizing that row's progress bar, so raise/lower `fill` to reflect how far that metric actually moved. WARNING: never invent a numeric before-value — qualitative before-states ('Missed calls', 'Referrals only') are what keep this section honest. Add a 4th/5th study by appending to `items` — the results index, card stack and mobile slider all read this array's length.
